mapper.sql: sch12_ipo_corp_id AS ipo_corp_id, sch12_corp_nm AS corp_name, sch12_homepage AS homepage
mapper.select: SELECT FROM sch12_ipo_corp WHERE upper(CONCAT(sch12_corp_nm, sch12_homepage)) LIKE upper(#{searchText})
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sch12_ipo_corp (sch12_ipo_corp_id, sch12_corp_nm, sch12_homepage) VALUES (#{ipoCorpId}, #{req.corpName}, #{req.homepage})
